row.known_text: 怎么尽可能多地说
row.target_text: How to speak as often as possible

row.known_text: 怎么用英语说一些东西
row.target_text: How to say something in English

row.known_text: 我打算试着解释我的意思
row.target_text: I'm going to try to explain what I mean

row.known_text: 我想在你说完以后能说话
row.target_text: I'd like to be able to speak after you finish

row.known_text: 你英语说得很好
row.target_text: You speak English very well

row.known_text: 我想让你明天和我说英语
row.target_text: And I want you to speak English with me tomorrow

row.known_text: 你想快点知道他的名字
row.target_text: You want to learn his name quickly

row.known_text: 你为什么在学她的名字？
row.target_text: Why are you learning her name?

row.known_text: 我打算很快开始多说
row.target_text: I'm going to start talking more soon

row.known_text: 在我必须走之前你能帮我吗？
row.target_text: Are you going to help me before I have to go?

row.known_text: 我喜欢那种快要准备好出发的感觉
row.target_text: I like feeling as if I'm nearly ready to go

row.known_text: 我昨天想问你一件事
row.target_text: I wanted to ask you something yesterday

row.known_text: 你今晚想和我说话
row.target_text: You wanted to speak with me tonight

row.known_text: 他不想在别人在的时候保持安静
row.target_text: He doesn't want to be quiet when other people are here

row.known_text: 她今天下午不想读任何东西
row.target_text: She doesn't want to read anything this afternoon

row.known_text: 你现在感觉怎么样？
row.target_text: How do you feel at the moment?

row.known_text: 学英语不容易，但是很有趣
row.target_text: Learning English isn't easy but it is fun

row.known_text: 我对自己已经学到的东西很满意
row.target_text: I'm very happy with how much I've learnt already

row.known_text: 我对自己开始理解的速度感到惊讶
row.target_text: I'm surprised at how quickly I'm starting to understand

row.known_text: 我不确定我什么时候能准备好
row.target_text: I'm not sure when I'll be ready

row.known_text: 我不打算等你。为什么不等？
row.target_text: I'm not going to wait for you. Why not?

row.known_text: 我还没准备好和不认识的人说话
row.target_text: I'm not ready to talk to people I don't know yet

row.known_text: 如果你能说慢一点就好了
row.target_text: If you can speak more slowly that would be great

row.known_text: 要想得够快来及时回答是很难的
row.target_text: It's difficult to think quickly enough to answer in time

row.known_text: 我想继续这样做一会儿
row.target_text: I'd like to keep on doing this for a while

row.known_text: 这是唯一能行得通的办法
row.target_text: This is the only way it will work

row.known_text: 你准备好坐下一班车回家了吗？
row.target_text: Are you ready to go home on the next bus?

row.known_text: 不，我还没准备好，我需要多一点时间
row.target_text: No I'm not ready yet, I need a little more time

row.known_text: 是的，你想走的时候我就准备好了
row.target_text: Yes I'm ready to go as soon as you want

row.known_text: 你应该问问自己为什么不行
row.target_text: You should ask yourself why it's not working

row.known_text: 我们希望看到你在做什么
row.target_text: We hoped to see what you were doing

row.known_text: 我们是朋友，结束以后我想放松一下
row.target_text: We're friends, and after we finish I'd like to relax

row.known_text: 那非常有意思，我没想到
row.target_text: That was very interesting, and I wasn't expecting it

row.known_text: 我觉得我还没准备好进行对话
row.target_text: I don't feel as if I'm ready to have a conversation

row.known_text: 我肯定比上次我们聊天的时候做得好了
row.target_text: I'm definitely doing better than I was last time we talked to each other

row.known_text: 你走之前我能问你一件事吗？
row.target_text: Can I ask you something before you leave?

row.known_text: 你不喜欢用你的车，这很不寻常
row.target_text: It's unusual that you don't like to use your car

row.known_text: 开始觉得容易了，我对进展很兴奋
row.target_text: It's starting to feel easier and I'm excited about how it's going

row.known_text: 我那时候觉得那是个好主意
row.target_text: I thought that was a good idea

row.known_text: 这项工作正在改变我的大脑结构
row.target_text: This work is changing the shape of my brain

row.known_text: 你做得这么好，我太高兴了
row.target_text: I'm so happy that you're doing so well

row.known_text: 我脑子里有太多想法了
row.target_text: There are too many ideas going around in my head

row.known_text: 那没有她说的那么令人兴奋
row.target_text: That's less exciting than what she was saying

row.known_text: 一起工作的时候你会很了解一个人
row.target_text: You get to know someone very well when you work together

row.known_text: 和他们一起做困难的事情不是问题
row.target_text: It's not a problem when you work at something difficult with them

row.known_text: 这就是我朋友想和我们见面的地方
row.target_text: This was where my friend wanted to meet us

row.known_text: 对不起，我需要这么早就走
row.target_text: I'm sorry that I need to leave so early

row.known_text: 对不起，我看不到你想给我看的东西
row.target_text: I'm sorry that I can't see what you're trying to show me

row.known_text: 你真好，我很感谢你的帮助
row.target_text: That's very kind of you and I'm grateful to you for helping

row.known_text: 我今天早上醒得比我想的早
row.target_text: I woke earlier than I wanted to this morning

row.known_text: 自从我们试着修好它以后，好像什么都不行了
row.target_text: Nothing seems to be working since we tried to fix it

row.known_text: 她看到我紧张的时候很友好
row.target_text: She was very kind when she saw me feeling nervous

row.known_text: 我回答不了的时候他不太有耐心
row.target_text: He wasn't very patient when I couldn't answer

row.known_text: 如果我知道你想要什么，我会做得不一样
row.target_text: I would have done it differently if I had known what you wanted

row.known_text: 我不会用完全一样的方式说
row.target_text: I wouldn't have said it in exactly the same way

row.known_text: 你星期六晚上想在哪里见面？
row.target_text: Where do you want to meet on Saturday night?

row.known_text: 下个月我不能去那里
row.target_text: I won't be able to be there next month

row.known_text: 星期天早上你能把那本书给我吗？
row.target_text: Can you give me that book on Sunday morning?

row.known_text: 你觉得那个怎么样？
row.target_text: What do you think about that?

row.known_text: 我觉得很有意思
row.target_text: I think that it's interesting

row.known_text: 我的名字不是很特别
row.target_text: My name is not very unusual

row.known_text: 然后我晚一点就能来帮忙了
row.target_text: And then I'll be able to come and help later on

row.known_text: 不用了谢谢，我自己能行
row.target_text: No thank you I can manage on my own

row.known_text: 我想看一会儿书
row.target_text: I'd like to read my book for a while

row.known_text: 你在哪里看到过我的钥匙吗？
row.target_text: Have you seen my keys anywhere?

row.known_text: 没有，恐怕我没看到过
row.target_text: No I'm afraid I haven't seen them

row.known_text: 看到过，刚才在办公室看到了
row.target_text: Yes I saw them in the office a while ago

row.known_text: 我觉得你把它们落在公司了
row.target_text: I think you left them at work

row.known_text: 你下个星期想说点不同的东西吗？
row.target_text: Do you want to talk about something different next week?

row.known_text: 我在试着找我放在桌子上的钱
row.target_text: I'm trying to find the money I left on the table

row.known_text: 你听说最新的想法了吗？
row.target_text: Have you heard the latest idea?

row.known_text: 我女儿在政府工作
row.target_text: My daughter works for the council

row.known_text: 他们说他们想确保我们按时完成所有的事情
row.target_text: They say they want to make sure that we finish everything in time

row.known_text: 没有人确定怎么回答这个问题
row.target_text: Nobody was sure how to answer the question

row.known_text: 我很享受和你练习说话的机会
row.target_text: I enjoy the chance to practise speaking with you

row.known_text: 他们想花更多时间作为一个团体见面
row.target_text: They want to spend more time meeting as a group

row.known_text: 他们想请求帮助
row.target_text: They wanted to ask for help

row.known_text: 我们不知道他们想要达到什么
row.target_text: We don't know what they're trying to achieve

row.known_text: 你周末过得好吗？
row.target_text: Did you have a good time at the weekend?

row.known_text: 我见了几个朋友
row.target_text: I saw a few friends

row.known_text: 星期天我没做什么
row.target_text: I didn't do much on Sunday

row.known_text: 能放松一会儿很好
row.target_text: It was nice to relax for a while

row.known_text: 他打算明天问你
row.target_text: He's going to ask you tomorrow

row.known_text: 那个男人在试着帮我
row.target_text: The man is trying to help me

row.known_text: 如果那个女人能帮你的话，她会帮的
row.target_text: That woman would help you if she could

row.known_text: 我认识一个想和你一起工作的年轻人
row.target_text: I know a young man who wants to work with you

row.known_text: 我认识一个想请求帮助的老人
row.target_text: I know an old man who wanted to ask for help

row.known_text: 我认识一个能记住答案的老太太
row.target_text: I know an old woman who can remember the answer

row.known_text: 我认识一个认识你姐姐的年轻女人
row.target_text: I know a young woman who knows your sister

row.known_text: 我昨晚遇到了一个和你哥哥一起工作的人
row.target_text: I met someone last night who works with your brother

row.known_text: 我打算点一样的东西吃
row.target_text: I'm going to ask for the same thing to eat

row.known_text: 我觉得那部电影太烂了，我要退钱
row.target_text: I thought the film was complete rubbish and I want my money back

row.known_text: 我觉得不到一个小时就能准备好
row.target_text: I think I'll be ready in less than an hour

row.known_text: 我一点都不知道
row.target_text: I don't have the faintest idea

row.known_text: 我觉得那可能是很重要的东西
row.target_text: I think it might be something important

row.known_text: 是的，她上个星期给我发了两封邮件
row.target_text: Yes she sent me two emails last week

row.known_text: 你是不是几天后就得走了？
row.target_text: Do you have to leave in a few days?

row.known_text: 你介意在你开始之前让我喝完咖啡吗？
row.target_text: Do you mind if I finish my coffee before you start?

row.known_text: 我没说过我想一天之内完成
row.target_text: I didn't say that I wanted to finish in a day

row.known_text: 她不想显得不友好
row.target_text: She doesn't want to seem unfriendly
